84dfec5a3b859e284998fc8124abae04e2fdd441:
mutation FlxSeoIndexNowSubmit($input: FlxSeoIndexNowSubmitInput!) {
  flxSeoIndexNowSubmit(input: $input) {
    submitted
    setup {
      ...FlxSeoSetupFields
    }
    errors {
      code
      message
      field
    }
  }
}

fragment FlxSeoSetupFields on FlxSeoSetup {
  otherPlugin
  aiReady
  blogName
  homeUrl
  sitemapUrl
  logoDefault
  imageDefault
  homeTitle
  homeDesc
  sitekit
  sitePublic
  indexnowKey
  indexnowUrl
  indexnowLast
  indexnowReady
  psiKeySaved
  adminEmail
  guideSections
  engines {
    key
    field
    name
    url
    link
    placeholder
    help
  }
}
